plugins.name: Codex Invite (with Usage Query)
plugins.description: Sends Codex referral invite emails AND queries Codex account usage (credit balance, rate-limit usage, referral reset credits) plus best-effort remaining-invite capacity, using a selected Codex OAuth credential. Fork of LTbinglingfeng/cpa-plugin-codex-invite with added query endpoints, plus quota-ordered auto-assignment of invitee emails across all active accounts (high quota first).
plugins.author: Hylouis233
